data.additional_information:
The Team You Will be Part Of:
- This role involves designing and developing world-class optical solutions within Nokia's Optical Networking team, collaborating with expert architects and engineers globally.
- You will address the exponential demand for optical infrastructure and computing power driven by the AI super cycle, utilizing the latest AI development tools and agile methodologies.
- The team fosters continuous learning and self-improvement, aligned with Nokia's organizational goals.

What you will learn and contribute to:
- Breakdown of requirements to formulate and understand overall systems using modern AI tools.
- Collaborate with Design and Architects to develop and integrate software, hardware, and FPGA solutions for Nokia's next-gen Optical products including third-party integration using modern AI tools.
- Engage in System design / Test reviews. High-level software modules design and critical code
reviews.
- Develop high-quality code in C++/Python and design/implement POCs for new software framework using modern AI Technologies.
- Use state-of-the-art AI tools for continuous integration pipelines and automation.
- Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to test, validate, and debug products for customer deliver.

Your Skills and Experience:
- Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- A good understanding of object-oriented concepts
- Very Strong in C/C++ /Python Programming skills
- Strong in Operating Systems, multi-threaded concepts
- Understanding /hands-on practice in Agile /AI Tools/Technologies 
- Project experience or academic specialization/electives in Optical/ Photonics
